_comment: Always show the story Skip button. UIEventWindow.skipPanel is activated in <startEvent>c__IteratorA.MoveNext from showSkipPanel (field 0x88); the click handler (OnClickSkip, 0xEC6CC0) just calls TextFX.Skip() with no gate. The only two writers of showSkipPanel in the binary are the generated chapter scripts, both shaped as 'showSkipPanel = chapter.<virtual bool>() & 1': the normal story (0x1533774) and the in-battle story (0x1534BF4). Replacing the 'and w8,w20,#1' with 'mov w8,#1' makes both unconditional. The story-archive replay (UIBookListItem -> PopupEvents) never touches the panel and would need its own patch.

patches.note: ChapterBase.startEvent coroutine: showSkipPanel = true (normal chapter story)
